blockquote.div: 1. User logs in on the Next.js frontend, credentials sent to Spring Boot.
2. Spring Boot validates the user in PostgreSQL and returns a JWT token.
3.Frontend sends the JWT with every API request, backend checks role and returns JSON data.

text.tspan: 1. User logs in on the Next.js frontend, credentials sent to Spring Boot.
2. Spring Boot validates the user in PostgreSQL and returns a JWT token.
3.Frontend sends the JWT with every API request, backend checks role and returns JSON data.
